Token.Name: Atlas personal token
Token.Hint: Create it in Atlas under Profile → Integrations and paste it here. It stays in this browser only and can only read your account's data.

Language.Name: Atlas language
Language.Hint: Choose the language for Atlas in this browser, or follow the Foundry language.

Source.Name: Atlas world, campaign and adventurers
Source.Label: Configure integration
Source.Hint: Choose the Atlas source and link player character sheets to campaign adventurers.
Source.NoToken: Save your personal token in the Atlas settings first, then reopen this window.
Source.WorldHint: With no campaign selected, access is to the world itself.

Links.ApprovalHint: Review and save the links to authorize document access in this campaign.
Links.Name: Player character sheets → Campaign adventurers
Links.Hint: For each Foundry Actor owned by a player, choose an adventurer from the selected Atlas campaign.
Links.Empty: No adventurers available in this campaign.
Links.NoPlayerActors: No player-owned Actors. Grant a player Owner permission on a character sheet to link it.

Importer.Title: Import from Atlas
Importer.NoToken: To import, create a token in Atlas (Profile → Integrations) and paste it in the module settings.
Importer.Done: Atlas: {created} created, {updated} updated, {failed} failed. Actors created: {actors}.
Importer.NoSource: Choose a world in the Atlas settings to import persons.
Importer.Subtitle: Bring the records of your world to the table.
Importer.ActorHint: Creates a name, image and journal link. Uses system defaults and preserves already linked character sheets.
Importer.CompendiumHint: Journal and Actor compendiums are private to the GM. Import records into the world to share them at the table.
Importer.PermissionsHint: Documents respect character links and accepted Atlas shares. Documents of an unlinked adventurer are GM-only.

Errors.Network: Could not reach Atlas. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.Unauthorized: The token is no longer valid. Create a new one in Atlas and paste it in the settings.
Errors.Forbidden: Your account cannot see this in Atlas.
Errors.SourceNotFound: The selected source is no longer available. Choose the world and campaign again.
Errors.InvalidLink: The Actor is no longer owned by a player or the adventurer is unavailable in this campaign. Reload the settings.
Errors.DuplicateAdventurer: A campaign adventurer can only be linked to one player character sheet.
Errors.InvalidImportKind: This record type is unavailable in this source.
Errors.InvalidActorType: Choose an Actor type supported by this game system.
Errors.InvalidAtlasResponse: Atlas returned an invalid record. The previous import was preserved.
Errors.InvalidPackType: A compendium with this name already exists with another document type.
Errors.PackNotPrivate: The Atlas compendium is shared. Make it private to players before importing documents.
Errors.PackLocked: The Atlas compendium is locked. Unlock it in Foundry before importing.
Errors.PermissionSync: Could not update Atlas document permissions. Check character links and reimport the records.

Sheet.Title: Atlas Person
Sheet.NoLocalPages: No local pages. Use Open journal to access the Foundry journal.
Sheet.NoDocuments: No imported documents. Reimport the person to include the documents available in Atlas.
Sheet.DocumentsSharing: Manage sharing for each document in Open journal.

ActorDocuments.Title: Atlas documents
ActorDocuments.Hint: Imported adventurer documents and accepted shares. This list respects your Foundry permissions.
ActorDocuments.Empty: No documents available. The GM can import documents and check the character link in the Atlas settings.
